criteria.description: One brand, four top-level entries (three plain links + one mega), three category groups of five title-only links, two media/title product cards, two actions, one toggle, and one chevron are authored
Exactly one primary navigation landmark and one links tree serve desktop and mobile

Native activation, stable desktop hover corridor, click pin, Escape with focus return from focused destinations, outside close, category-link/product-card/CTA close, mobile nested disclosure, same-breakpoint resize stability, and breakpoint-crossing reset reach every documented state
Desktop full-width panel under bar; tablet mid-width readable composition; mobile in-flow; narrow 320/340 widths and 767/768/769 seams without html/root overflow; fully visible 44px targets
Each product card is exactly one anchor with media + title only, no nested interactive descendant, no rendered description, and visible focus
JavaScript-disabled mobile exposes the one tree, both actions, and usable native disclosure
WCAG 2.1 AA axe on the block root; light/dark token surfaces; reduced-motion disables block-local transitions; single chevron/close affordance
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief
